svg.title: A crash and restart on the same configuration
svg.desc: The vehicle runs A and crashes. A datum sent before the crash arrives before the new start's first beacon and is read with A. A command the station sent before hearing of the restart reaches the new start, which is not matched, so it is not acted on, and its refusal is dropped and counted. The flagged beacon ends the match. CONNECT with A matches again; the station drops anything queued and reads and commands with A.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold

svg.text: Arrowhead: read or acted on. Cross: dropped and counted, or not acted on. The words at each end say which.
